title: Dot-to-pill identity tag
summary: A white dot grows into a capsule on black, then a name fades in, an avatar slides in from the left and a verified seal pops on the right. Strict one-thing-per-beat phasing in 1.13 s; only the seal bounces.
use_when: A 3 s social sticker or lower-third that tags a person, account or product
Introducing a founder or creator before a longer clip
A loopable handle or name reveal for a feed post
Any moment where a small UI chip should read as switching on

look.type_style: bold grotesk, all caps, tight, cap height ~7 % H, near-black on the white capsule

sfx.event: verified seal pops in at the right end (f29)

structure.shot: one white capsule centred on near-black: avatar circle left, a 2-word all-caps name, verified seal right; then a long hold
structure.camera: static (block match reads 0.2 %/s zoom in the hold, at noise level; pill size identical in cells 4-11)
structure.motion: f0-1 black; capsule uniform scale from a 3 px dot, aspect ~4:1 throughout, cubic-bezier(0.5,0.1,0.45,1) over 12 fr (f2-14), radius = height/2, no overshoot; label opacity 0 to 1 near-linear 7 fr (f14-21) in a reserved slot; avatar slides in from ~150 px left, ~200 px travel, easings.outQuint 6 fr (f19-25), no overshoot; seal scale 0 to 1, notifSprings.badge (360/26/1, ~5 % overshoot) peak ~7 fr (f27-34); static hold f37-90

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the backdrop, a light fill for the capsule, display font for the name, accent for the seal
params.content.label: the name or handle, 1-2 words, all caps, fits ~60 % of the capsule width
params.content.avatar: square photo or logo for the leading circle; falls back to initials on a brand gradient
params.content.trailing: trailing proof glyph: verified seal (default), check, or none
params.timing.at: frame the dot appears (default 2 at 30 fps)
params.timing.hold: frames the finished tag holds (default 53, to a 90 fr total)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; capsule width 40 % of frame width at 16:9, capped for vertical
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Frame numbers taken from the hand-measured 30 fps notes for this reference; 4 fps sheets confirm the order (0.27 small capsule, 0.50 full capsule empty, 0.77 name + avatar entering, 1.27 seal present). Final capsule 40 % W x 18 % H. Phases overlap: each starts when the previous is ~70 % done; total build 34 fr. The avatar leaks outside the capsule in the source at 0.77; rebuild masks it inside the capsule. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (source is silent). Proposed term: dot-capsule-grow (pill scales uniformly from a point; not island-morph's top-anchored notch, not logo-from-dot).
